summary: Implemented Lambda (vanilla, monai/transforms/utility/array.py) and Lambdad (dictionary, monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py) with aliases LambdaD and LambdaDict, added docs entries in docs/source/transforms.rst, and added tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. The git diff of dictionary.py removes only the original typing import line, which the spec permits. Tests, flake8, and black were not run, per instructions; the checks were done by reading only.
